evidence.source: SI section 2/Table S1 identifies the crystallographic deposition and compound identity context for the B2N6 derivatives, including CCDC 2512981.
Main paper data-availability/crystallographic statement cites CCDC 2512981-2512983.
Main paper computational discussion assigns compound 1 visible absorption to an N6-centred HOMO-LUMO transition and reports its oscillator strength.
Main paper continuation gives the comparative orbital interpretation and dominant transition discussion.
SI computational-study section states Gaussian 16, B3LYP/6-31+G(d), SMD dichloromethane and DFT-D3BJ for optimization and TD-DFT.
SI Table S2 first excited state reports 3.0119 eV and f=0.3456.
SI Table S2 continuation/state record supports the state-resolved excitation and oscillator-strength reference.
